item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello! Happy weekend! Here is your weather report for Sunday, October 4. It's Sunday, a good day to rest and get ready for the week. Here in Shanghai, the day will be on and off showers. Temperatures will go up to 23 degrees, with a low of 19. It should feel gently warm all day. Rain is about 100 percent likely today. The sun goes down at 5:35 this evening, about 2 minutes earlier than yesterday. Can you feel the days getting shorter? Remember to take an umbrella with you! And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be overcast, with a high of 22 degrees. Here's a question: what is the kindest thing you can do today? That's all from the weather desk. Enjoy your day!
